<!--
Thanks for contributing to h6s!

We encourage you to use AI to assist you in researching, creating, and reviewing changes. However, you must review and deeply understand what you submit. For this reason, **pull request descriptions from external contributors must be written by a human**.

## Title

Use the format `<type>(<scope>): <subject>`, for example `fix(calendar): handle disabled dates`.
The type is one of feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, or chore. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/toss/h6s/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#commit-message-conventions).

## Before you open this

Complete the checklist for your type of change and delete the sections that do not apply.
-->

### Adding or changing a feature

- [ ] The related feature request is linked with `fixes #number` or `refs #number`.
- [ ] The implementation and relevant tests are included.
- [ ] Documentation and examples are updated when user-facing behavior changes.
- [ ] A changeset is included when a published package changes.

### Fixing a bug

- [ ] The related issue is linked with `fixes #number` or `refs #number`.
- [ ] A regression test that fails without this change is included.
- [ ] A changeset is included when a published package changes.

### Documentation, tests, or internal tooling

- [ ] Relevant documentation, tests, or checks have been updated.
- [ ] A changeset is included only when the change affects a published package.
